steps: Checked windscreen options for the SR5
Added camera bracket glass and moulding

lines.reason_short: SR5 windscreen with camera bracket for the lane-keep camera.
lines.reason_long: The cracked windscreen needs replacing, and the SR5 has a lane-keep camera so it takes the bracket version. It is non-returnable and over $150, so it needs your confirmation.

lines.reason_short: Moulding kit is needed when refitting a new windscreen.
lines.reason_long: A new windscreen needs a fresh moulding kit to seal and finish the edge. It is cheap and returnable, but depends on the windscreen being confirmed.

lines.reason_short: Lane-keep camera must be calibrated after windscreen replacement.
lines.reason_long: This Hilux SR5 has a windscreen-mounted lane-keep camera that needs recalibrating after the glass is changed. It depends on the windscreen being confirmed.

result.reply: I suggested the SR5 windscreen with camera bracket, the moulding kit and the camera calibration for you to confirm.
